notes: A decent core flavor from Alani. Sticks true to tasting like blueberry. Not my go to, but gym and road trip satisfying.
body:
One of Alani's core flavors meant to be a traditional blueberry.

Overall on taste: Solid. It's quite sweet. Probably sweeter than the juicy peach, but the "berry" tartness that all drink flavors have cut through it quite nicely. Overall, the taste is slightly similar to Gatorade's dark blue sugar free flavor, with a more pronounced blueberry taste, that's sweeter and slightly tart. On taste alone, it's around an 8.

The other areas drag it down a bit more - I don't mind the cough syrup flavor, but it can be a drawback for those who are very averse. Not as much as cosmic stardust, but it's there in the aftertaste. Also, unlike juicy peach or wild cherry, it has some mouth dryness associated with it. Nothing too bad and can be overcome with just a bit of water and goes away, but it exists.

Overall, this is an abundant option that's decent. I see it in nearly every store.
name: Blue Slush
